question: What scope of reality can be illumined with immediate swiftness?
premises: Moving and unmoving entities together constitute all existence.
The three worlds encompass this entire totality.
This complete totality can be illumined swiftly.
inference: The entirety of the three worlds, both moving and unmoving, is capable of being illumined instantly.
uncertainties: The implicit subject or agent of illumination is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Just as it may quickly illumine all the three worlds, moving and unmoving.
